---
title: "set_title"
author: "Tom Naber"
date: "`r format(Sys.Date(), '%B %d, %Y')`"

knit: (function(inputFile, encoding) { rmarkdown::render(inputFile, encoding = encoding, params = "ask", output_file = here::here("Output", paste0(tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(inputFile)), ".html")))})
  
output:
  html_document:
    theme: cosmo
    toc: true
    toc_float: true
    number_sections: true
    df_print: paged
    highlight: tango
    self_contained: true
    fig_width: 6.4
    fig_height: 4.8
    code_folding: hide
    
editor_options:
  markdown:
    wrap: 80
  chunk_output_type: inline
  
params:
  save_figures:
    label: "Save figures"
    value: FALSE
---

# Set-up

## Set options & import sources

```{r setup, include=FALSE, cache = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(fig.width = 6.4,
                      fig.height = 4.8,
                      dpi = 300,
                      fig.retina = 1,
                      out.width = "100%",
                      out.height = "100%",
                      dev = "ragg_png")

knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = here::here())

options(contrasts = c("contr.sum", "contr.poly"))

library(ragg)
library(here)
library(sameplot)

source(here("Scripts", "universal_helpers.R"))
```
